description.value: Bonus to Deception or Diplomacy when invoking a corporate rank, contract clause, or chain of command — but corporate security systems and rival-corp agents recognize the accent and posture just as easily as your own people do.

cinderfall.incomplete: The card states a bonus but gives no numeric value, bonus type, or specific action tag to build a FlatModifier from without inventing one. (It also has an unencodable narrative drawback: corp security recognizes the same accent/posture.)
